build_s3cache_init: build an S3Cache instance with an S3 bucket name and optional region, endpoint, and credentials
create_set_cache: create a cache entry in S3 with a key, serialized value, and optional TTL expiration
test_get_cache: test retrieving a cached value from S3 by key, handling expiration and missing keys
refactor_async_set_cache: refactor the async S3 cache set operation to run in an executor and avoid blocking the event loop
review_async_get_cache: review the async S3 cache get operation that deserializes JSON and handles client errors
